title: rule-set zip caps and where a rule set's signature is checked (plan 10 row 10G-6)
note: basis 'shown' means shown by reading the code, not by running an attack. The update path itself verifies the bundle signature and each payload's sha256 before the rule-set zip is opened.

findings.claim: python -m criteria_compiler.import_ruleset FILE installs any zip given to it whose own manifest says approved; the module checks no signature itself (services/criteria_compiler/import_ruleset.py main); only the update path in front of it does (tools/verify_update.py:243); reaching it needs a shell in the criteria-compiler container

the trial simulation runs the SQL of a compiler draft zip read from the object store (services/orchestrator/scenarios/trials.py:63 and :97 -> cohort.load_draft -> feas_compute.py:274) with no signature or hash binding the stored zip to the compile result that named it; changing it needs write access to the object store; only check_select and the read-only lake bound the SQL
